definitions.daily_average: aggregate count at each native 10ms bin divided by 116 accepted trading days
definitions.equal_day_per_million: mean across days of bin count divided by that market-day total matched cancels, times one million
definitions.heatmap: five adjacent native bins combined to 50ms, normalized within each market-day per million matched cancels
definitions.peak_baseline: median aggregate count in +/-250ms excluding +/-80ms around the candidate
definitions.peak_persistence: day counted when the maximum within +/-50ms is at least 2x that day's local baseline
